articles.title: ‘Exciting new phase’ for India–US partnership, says envoy
articles.summary: India's Ambassador to the US, Vinay Mohan Kwatra, lauded a recent India-US deal, emphasizing its potential to unlock vast opportunities for both nations. He highlighted the significance of high-level discussions between the leaders. This agreement underscores strengthening bilateral ties and strategic cooperation, crucial for regional stability and economic growth, reflecting important developments in international diplomacy for SSB aspirants.

articles.title: Johnnette delivers third batch of JM-1 loitering munitions to Indian Army under emergency procurement
articles.summary: Johnnette Technologies, an Indian manufacturer, has successfully delivered the third batch of its indigenously developed JM-1 loitering munitions to the Indian armed forces. This milestone highlights India's growing self-reliance in advanced defence technology, particularly in unmanned systems. Such capabilities are crucial for modern warfare, enhancing surveillance and precision strike options for our troops on the ground, strengthening national security.

articles.title: Vodafone: New subsea interconnection between Crete and Athens via Milos
articles.summary: Vodafone Carrier Services is constructing a new high-capacity subsea fiber optic cable system in Greece. This critical infrastructure project will connect the island of Crete to the mainland, significantly enhancing internet access and digital connectivity for residents and businesses. Such advancements in communication technology are vital for national development and economic growth, aligning with global trends in digital transformation.

articles.title: OpenClaw and Moltbook: why a DIY AI agent and social media for bots feel so new (but really aren’t)
articles.summary: The article introduces OpenClaw, an artificial intelligence entity also known as Clawdbot or Moltbot, which has gained significant traction on social media. Its mention reflects the increasing public engagement and growing familiarity with various evolving AI technologies and their presence within online communities, highlighting a key area of modern technological development.
